correctness.rationale: For positive speed, flip rate, diffusivity and fixed positive window, almost-sure reachability follows from a centered nondegenerate two-flip skeleton. Strong Markov at successive record levels and uniqueness of bounded two-component hitting-probability ODE solutions yield the exact spatial generator. Its independent exponential alternating sojourn construction under diffusivity tending to zero couples starts to a homogeneous Poisson point process and scaled widths to independent exponential marks; the terminal truncated island is negligible. A tilted 2-by-2 Feynman-Kac eigenvalue calculation independently verifies the compound-Poisson Laplace law and supplies uniform exponential integrability for all moments. The code checks generator identities, a published one-point fraction, and finite-window transforms; numerical tests are not the proof.

value.rationale: The 2026 physical model explicitly motivates microscopic patches of opposite paint, but expected colored volumes cannot determine the chance of a patch or its count/size law. The theorem gives a complete fixed-window rare-patch point process, a non-Gaussian compound-Poisson amplified coverage law, and the nonzero probability of one or more counter-oriented patches even while their total unscaled area vanishes. These facts distinguish topological patch occurrence from area fractions and quantify a physically natural zero-thermal-noise boundary, beyond a numerical parameter substitution.
